# Ebay.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/ebay-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/ebay-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects product listing data from Ebay.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Ebay Using Python (2025 Update)](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-ebay)
- **Code:** [`ebay.py`](ebay.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Product pages](results/product.json) · [Product pages with variant](results/product-with-variants.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- Ebay.com product search.
- Ebay.com product data.
- Ebay.com product variant data.

## Functions

- `scrape_product(url)` → `Dict`: Scrape ebay.com product listing page for product data
- `scrape_product_variants(url)` → `List[Dict]`: Scrape ebay.com product listing page for variant data (price, stock, quantity, images)
- `scrape_search(url, max_pages=None)` → `List[Dict]`: Scrape Ebay's search for product preview data for given

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import ebay


async def main():
    search = await ebay.scrape_search(
        "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_from=R40&_nkw=iphone&_sacat=0&LH_TitleDesc=0&Storage%2520Capacity=16%2520GB&_dcat=9355&_ipg=240&rt=nc&LH_All=1",
        max_pages=2,
    )
    product = await ebay.scrape_product("https://www.ebay.com/itm/206259394920")
    product_variants = await ebay.scrape_product_variants("https://www.ebay.com/itm/206259394920")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/product.json`](results/product.json): `url`, `id`, `price_original`, `price_converted`, `name`, `seller_name`, `seller_url`, `photos`, `description_url`, `features`
- [`results/product-with-variants.json`](results/product-with-variants.json): `id`, `Card`, `price_original`, `price_original_currency`, `price_converted`, `price_converted_currency`, `out_of_stock`, `quantity_available`, `images`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `url`, `title`, `price`, `shipping`, `location`, `subtitles`, `photo`, `rating`, `rating_count`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`ebay.py`](ebay.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly's [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker), its anti-bot bypass
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy
- `lang` = `["en-US"]`: browser language

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/ebay-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_product_scraping`, `test_product_variants_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
